children.html:
Dive Into Advanced Rescue Skills

PADI Rescue Diver

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-1fcf773b elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: At Mocean Beach Resort, our PADI Rescue Diver course prepares certified divers to manage dive emergencies with confidence. This course takes place in the pristine waters of West Sumbawa, Indonesia, where experienced instructors guide you through realistic rescue scenarios and problem-solving exercises. Dive with just two certified divers per instructor for a personalized learning experience. Expect encounters with diverse marine life, including manta rays, reef sharks, and eagle rays, in visibility up to 15 meters. Our diver-centered facilities include private lockers, a wet area, and an air-conditioned camera room to ensure your comfort and safety throughout the course.

Tailored Rescue Training

Your Rescue Diver Course

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-41c6c346 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: The course spans three days and includes pool training and open water dives designed to simulate emergency situations. Each session emphasizes diver safety, risk assessment, and rescue planning. From beginner rescue scenarios to complex underwater problem-solving, our instructors ensure that every participant gains confidence and competence. By the end of the course, you will have the skills to assist other divers in distress and manage emergencies efficiently.

From Depths Up

Relax, Recharge, and Discover Sumbawa

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-414c3fcf elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Your dive adventure doesn’t end when you surface. Mocean Beach Resort offers quiet beaches, breathtaking sunsets, and easy access to Sumbawa’s hidden gems. Spend an afternoon exploring nearby villages, trek to cascading waterfalls, or simply unwind with a massage after a day of diving. Whether you crave exploration or pure relaxation, our boutique setting lets you enjoy Indonesia’s natural beauty at your own pace. Every stay is designed to refresh your body and inspire your next dive.

Experience More Than Diving

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-160304c elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor

Hike scenic coastal trails, visit traditional fishing villages, or take a day trip to secluded beaches where you can swim, snorkel, and soak in untouched beauty. Whether you’re chasing adrenaline or peaceful escapes, every moment here adds a new layer to your Indonesian journey.

children.html:
Do I need prior rescue training?

Yes, you should be a certified diver (Open Water or equivalent) before enrolling in the PADI Rescue Diver course.

What skills will I learn?

You’ll gain techniques to prevent and manage dive emergencies, perform rescues, and assist fellow divers safely.

How large are the training groups?

Groups are kept small, maximum two students per instructor, for personalized guidance and hands-on practice.

Where does the course take place?

Training includes controlled pool sessions and open water dives in the clear, pristine waters of West Sumbawa.

What facilities support the course?

Our dive center provides private lockers, a wet area, and an air-conditioned camera room to keep your gear and footage safe
